record.question: In India, the full form of THOTA Act is:
options: Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act
Transplantation of Heart and Organs technical Act
Transplantation Hospitals and Organ Trade Act
record.explanation: Answer A: Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act. THOTA is the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994, as amended in 2011; the source’s option omits the year but gives the correct title. Reference: https://notto.mohfw.gov.in/WriteReadData/Portal/News/THOA2011.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
